title: abutilon globiflorum
intro: Abutilon globiflorum, commonly known as the Mexican thistle or Butterfly flower, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. Traditionally, it is used in Mexican medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Abutilon globiflorum include its potential to reduce inflammation, alleviate fever, and soothe digestive issues, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which have been identified through phytochemical analysis.
